Root cause: The tabs component interprets ArrowDown as a navigation key for vertical tablist due to missing aria-orientation attribute, causing focus to shift to next tab when down arrow pressed. Repair strategy: Add aria-orientation="horizontal" to the tablist element to inform the widget that arrow keys left/right navigate tabs, while up/down have no effect (or move focus within panel). Expected accessibility effect: Pressing ArrowDown while focus is on a tab will not change the selected tab; focus remains on same tab, preserving horizontal tab navigation behavior per WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3. Functional risks: Potential impact on screen reader users who rely on vertical arrow navigation if they expected vertical tablist; but tablist is horizontal visually, so risk low. Also possible conflict if any custom scripts rely on missing attribute.
